sentence_text: New developments in the field of Artificial Intelligence (“AI”) could enable competitors to offer new products or services never before seen in the marketplace.

While we strive to provide the most cutting-edge technology to our customers, breakthroughs or significant innovations made using AI (or discoveries uncovered through the use of AI) could change the nature of our business.
Scrutiny in the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and information security by regulatory and legislative authorities has increased.
